description: LIST every block — THE BLOCK MENU — when called with no type: one short row per block — what it is, when to pick it, how many entries it is designed for, which slots it draws, and its styles, shapes, figures and marks. WITH a type: that block in depth — each shape's own count range, the icon vocabulary, and a worked example ready to copy into add_block. Block types are discovered here, never memorised. There is no per-block color, font or size on this surface: those values are the theme's and the theme is the account's. Change how a block LOOKS with its `variant`.

type.description: A block type, e.g. "timeline". Omit for the menu of every block.

title: The block menu, or one block in depth
